Founded in {{ill|Enryaku|de|Enryaku|es|Enryaku|fa|انریاکو|fr|Ère Enryaku|ia|Enryaku|id|Enryaku|it|Enryaku|ja|延暦|ko|엔랴쿠|pt|Enryaku|ru|Энряку (нэнго)|simple|Enryaku|sr|Енрјаку|tr|Enryaku|uk|Енряку (ненґо)|zh|延曆|zh_yue|延曆|qid=Q1373176}} 13 ({{ill|794|ab|794|af|794|als|794|am|794 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|794|ar|794|ary|794|ast|794|avk|794|az|794|azb|۷۹۴ (میلادی)|bcl|794|be|794|be_x_old|794|bg|794|bn|৭৯৪|bpy|মারি ৭৯৪|br|794|bs|794.|ca|794|cdo|794 nièng|ceb|794|ckb|٧٩٤|crh|794|cs|794|cv|794|cy|794|da|794|de|794|el|794|eml|794|eo|794|es|794|et|794|eu|794|fa|۷۹۴ (میلادی)|fi|794|fo|794|fr|794|fy|794|ga|794|gan|794年|gd|794|gl|794|he|794|hi|794|hr|794.|ht|794 (almanak jilyen)|hu|794|hy|794|id|794|io|794|is|794|it|794|ja|794年|jv|794|ka|794|kaa|794|kk|794 жыл|ko|794년|la|794|lb|794|lij|794|lmo|794|lt|794 m.|lv|794. gads|map_bms|794|mdf|794|mg|794|mhr|794|mk|794|mr|इ.स. ७९४|mrj|794 и|ms|794|mzn|۷۹۴|nah|794|nap|794|nds|794|new|सन् ७९४|nl|794|nn|794|no|794|nrm|794|nso|794|oc|794|or|୭୯୪|os|794-æм аз|pl|794|pnb|794|pt|794|qu|794|ro|794|ru|794 год|rue|794|sa|७९४|scn|794|sd|794ع|sh|794.|shn|794|si|794|simple|794|sk|794|sl|794|sq|794|sr|794|su|794|sv|794|sw|794|tg|Соли 794|th|พ.ศ. 1337|tk|794|tl|794|tly|794|tr|794|tt|794 ел|uk|794|ur|794ء|uz|794|vec|794|vi|794|war|794|wuu|794年|xmf|794|zh|794年|zh_min_nan|794 nî|zh_yue|794年|qid=Q30887}}). When they worshiped {{ill|Lycopodium clavatum|arz|ليكوبوديوم كلافاتوم|ast|Lycopodium clavatum|az|Sancağabənzər plaun|azb|سانجاغابنزر پلاون|ba|Көкөрт үләне|be|Дзераза булавападобная|be_x_old|Дзераза булавападобная|bg|Бухалковиден плаун|ca|Lycopodium clavatum|ceb|Lycopodium clavatum|cs|Plavuň vidlačka|csb|Mòrzebób|cy|Cnwp-fwsogl corn carw|da|Almindelig ulvefod|de|Keulen-Bärlapp|es|Lycopodium clavatum|et|Karukold|fa|پنجه‌گرگی شاخ‌گوزنی|fi|Katinlieko|fr|Lycopodium clavatum|ga|Garbhógach na mbeann|hi|नागबेली|hu|Kapcsos korpafű|id|Rumput kawat|is|Burstajafni|it|Lycopodium clavatum|ja|ヒカゲノカズラ|ka|გველის ხავსი|kk|Шоқпарбас плаун|ko|석송|lt|Vaistinis pataisas|lv|Vālīšu staipeknis|mk|Волчја нога|ne|नागबेली|nl|Grote wolfsklauw|no|Myk kråkefot|pl|Widłak goździsty|qu|China wiñay wayna|ru|Плаун булавовидный|sco|Lycopodium clavatum|se|Idni|sk|Plavúň obyčajný|sv|Mattlummer|to|Ikuʻikulī|tr|Lycopodium clavatum|uk|Плаун звичайний|vi|Thạch tùng|war|Lycopodium clavatum|zh|东北石松|qid=Q466426|lt=hikagekazura}} growing east of this shrine, {{ill|Emperor Heizei|ar|الإمبراطور هيزيه|arz|الامبراطور هيزى|azb|هی‌زی (ایمپیراتور)|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر ھێیزێی|cs|Heizei|de|Heizei|es|Heizei Tennō|eu|Heizei enperadorea|fa|امپراتور هی‌زی|fr|Heizei|id|Kaisar Heizei|it|Heizei|ja|平城天皇|ko|헤이제이 천황|mn|Эзэн Хаан Хэйзэй|nl|Heizei|pl|Heizei|pt|Heizei|ru|Император Хэйдзэй|sh|Car Heizei|simple|Emperor Heizei|sl|Cesar Heizei|sr|Хеизеи|sv|Heizei|sw|Heizei wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิเฮเซ (อาเตะ)|tl|Emperador Heizei|tr|Heizei (imparator)|uk|Імператор Хейдзей|vi|Thiên hoàng Heizei|yo|Emperor Heizei|zh|平城天皇|zh_min_nan|Heizei Thian-hông|qid=Q353558}} granted the divine title Hikage Daimyōjin and the imperial poem "Kamiyama no hikage no tsura kazatefu toyo no akari no wakete kumanaki." Since then, hikagekazura has been the shrine crest.

It was later designated an {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Engishiki inner shrine}}, became a prayer shrine of {{ill|Emperor Go-Suzaku|azb|قو-سوزاکو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Go-Suzaku|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر گۆ-سوزاکو|cs|Go-Suzaku|de|Go-Suzaku|el|Αυτοκράτορας Γκο-Σουζάκου|eo|Imperiestro Go-Suzaku|es|Go-Suzaku Tennō|fa|امپراتور گو-سوزاکو|fr|Go-Suzaku|id|Go-Suzaku|it|Go-Suzaku|ja|後朱雀天皇|ko|고스자쿠 천황|mr|गो-सुझाकु|nl|Go-Suzaku|pl|Go-Suzaku|pt|Go-Suzaku|ru|Император Го-Судзаку|sh|Car Go-Suzaku|sv|Go-Suzaku|sw|Go-Suzaku wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิโกะ-ซูซากุ|tl|Emperador Go-Suzaku|tr|Go-Suzaku|uk|Імператор Ґо-Судзаку|vi|Thiên hoàng Go-Suzaku|yo|Emperor Go-Suzaku|zh|後朱雀天皇|zh_min_nan|Go-Suzaku Thian-hông|qid=Q349296}} and {{ill|Emperor Go-Reizei|azb|قو-ریزی (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Go-Reizei|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر گۆ-ڕێیزێی|cs|Go-Reizei|de|Go-Reizei|es|Go-Reizei Tennō|fa|امپراتور گو-ری‌زی|fr|Go-Reizei|id|Kaisar Go-Reizei|it|Go-Reizei|ja|後冷泉天皇|ko|고레이제이 천황|mr|गो-राइझाइ|nds|Go-Reizei|nl|Go-Reizei|pl|Go-Reizei|pt|Go-Reizei|ru|Император Го-Рэйдзэй|sh|Car Go-Reizei|sv|Go-Reizei|sw|Go-Reizei wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิโกะ-เรเซ|tl|Emperador Go-Reizei|tr|Go-Reizei|uk|Імператор Ґо-Рейдзей|vi|Thiên hoàng Go-Reizei|yo|Emperor Go-Reizei|zh|後冷泉天皇|zh_min_nan|Go-Reizei Thian-hông|qid=Q356060}}, and Amida-ji was founded as its shrine temple.

It enshrined {{ill|Gozu Tennō|de|Gozu-Tennō|it|Gozu Tennō|ja|牛頭天王|zh|牛頭天王|qid=Q11570247}} and drew worship for reputed efficacy in rain-prayer rituals.
